compactRuleHints.TEMPERATURE_PATTERN: All inputs; strictly rising; final samples:

compactStateHints.NOT_MATCHED: Pattern not matched; no health assessment.

attentionNoneHint: A null attention band does not mean low risk or establish vehicle health.
noThresholds: No thresholds supplied in this evaluation
thresholdHint: These are versioned example thresholds supplied by the server. They are not verified manufacturer limits.
missingInput: Required input unavailable to this evaluation
measurementLogUnavailable: Exact measurement log unavailable in this selection
referenceUnavailable: Exact referenced record unavailable in this selection
contributorHint: Only the server's exact referenced inputs are shown. Zero is a value; unavailable values remain unavailable. Other observations are not substituted.
noMissingEvidenceReported: No additional missing-evidence reason supplied by this rule
limitationsHint: A matching rule can still have missing context. These results do not establish a diagnosis, a repair, a failure probability or vehicle health.
positionGaps: Identified position gaps in the loaded example day
positionGapHint: Position coverage describes the example day, separately from this rule's input window. A gap between recorded positions does not establish a sensor outage or continuous signal history. Its intervals are available in the source details.
clockHint: The input window starts inclusively and ends exclusively. Observation times, rule processing, retrieval and the fixed example clock retain their separate meanings.

ruleHints.REPEATED_FAULT: This rule counts fault-report records for the same fault in its input window. Status changes are not counted as additional reports.
ruleHints.TEMPERATURE_PATTERN: This rule requires every required sample, a strictly rising sequence, and the required number of final samples at or above the temperature threshold. It evaluates discrete samples; continuous overheating is not established.
ruleHints.VOLTAGE_PATTERN: This rule requires every required sample, each at or below the voltage threshold. A missing required value leaves the rule with insufficient data.

stateHints.MATCHED: The supplied inputs met this version of the example rule. This is an explainable pattern, not a confirmed vehicle fault.
stateHints.NOT_MATCHED: The supplied inputs did not meet this example rule. This does not establish that the vehicle is healthy.
stateHints.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Required usable inputs are missing. The rule cannot establish whether its pattern matches.

attentionHints.MONITOR: The server assigned the illustrative monitor band to this matched pattern. It is not fault severity or a predicted failure.
attentionHints.REVIEW: The server assigned the illustrative review band to the repeated-report pattern. It does not verify a manufacturer DTC meaning or prescribe a repair.

thresholdKinds.MINIMUM_REPORTS: Minimum fault reports in the window
thresholdKinds.MINIMUM_HIGH_SAMPLES: Minimum final samples at or above the temperature threshold

missingEvidenceLabels.SIGNAL_VALUE_UNAVAILABLE: A required sample has no usable value. This does not establish a sensor outage.
missingEvidenceLabels.CONTINUOUS_TEMPERATURE_HISTORY_UNAVAILAB: Only discrete temperature samples are available; continuous temperature history is unavailable.
missingEvidenceLabels.VEHICLE_LIMITS_UNVERIFIED: The example thresholds have not been verified against this vehicle's limits.
missingEvidenceLabels.MANUFACTURER_FAULT_MEANING_UNVERIFIED: The fault code's manufacturer-specific meaning has not been verified.
